records.subject: Welcome aboard, Blue Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Blue Dynamics* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 (2026-09-08) but nothing since; no invite sent, no key milestone, no tickets, and only a welcome email [email:0336f891] plus a held kickoff [calendar:7dc6ad34]. Engagement went quiet after kickoff with 8 days left, so unaided activation is possible but unlikely on a solo Starter account.

draft.subject: Next step after our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks again for the kickoff last week — good to see Blue Dynamics already has a first project set up in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's a solid start.

Since Wrenfield gets more useful once someone else is in it, the usual next step is adding a teammate — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help us line up that next step together?

Best,
Nadia
